The '''Ruins of Unkah''' are ancient ruins in the [[Kharidian Desert]], now inhabited by the [[Spirit Anglers]], who have set up camp to research and subdue [[Tempoross]]. A small [[Ruins of Unkah mine|mine]] is located atop a cliff north of the ruins.

==Transportation==
The Ruins of Unkah can be reached from [[Al Kharid]] by boarding [[Ferryman Sathwood]]'s ferry. If entering from the desert, the player must go through either of the [[Shantay pass (scenery)|Shantay pass]]es located on the southern and eastern borders of the ruins. Players can take [[Ferryman Nathwood]]'s ferry back to Al Kharid.

==History==
Little is known about Unkah, but it can be presumed based on its name and its ruined state that like [[Uzer]] and [[Ullek]], Unkah was a settlement during the [[God Wars]] which was destroyed by [[Zamorak]]'s forces.

Recently, the crew of ''[[The Desert Trout]]'', a group of fishermen, washed up on the shore of [[Al Kharid]] after their ship was sunk by a [[Tempoross|sea spirit]].{{CiteText|text=The desert trout - ship's log}} They reported the incident to [[Chancellor Hassan]] who formed the [[Spirit Anglers]] in response, and they set up in the Ruins of Unkah near [[Tempoross Cove]] to research and subdue Tempoross.{{CiteNPC|npc=Captain Pudi|quote=The Chancellor called a meeting for all us local seafarin' folk and we agreed action must be taken! Ain't nothin' goin' t' take the seas from me, even if it is a powerful spirit! Anyway, it was decided that we'd setup a base 'ere amongst these ruins, and so the Spirit Anglers was formed!{{nbsp}}[...] Since moving in, we've been recruiting fisherfolk from all over, and some of the readin' types 'ave been studyin' Tempoross durin' our trips to subdue it.|loc=|notes=|name=}}

==Locations==
===Sea Spirit Dock===
[[File:Sea Spirit Dock.png|thumb|250px|The Sea Spirit Dock west of the ruins.]]
The Sea Spirit Dock is where players arrive if travelling via Al Kharid. Here, players can board the docked ship via a rope ladder, where they are taken to [[Tempoross Cove]] to help subdue [[Tempoross]], an ancient sea spirit. Players can learn the fight mechanics from [[Captain Pudi]], and [[Captain Dudi]] will announce the time until the next fight starts.

The dock also features the reward pool, where players can use a [[small fishing net]] to collect rewards from subduing Tempoross. The nearby [[Spirit Angler|spirit angler]] hands out small fishing nets. The [[retired sailor]] will exchange some of these rewards for [[soaked page]]s. Finally, [[Spirit Angler stats|a noticeboard]] next to the pier displays statistics related to Tempoross.

Players in need of [[Shantay Pass|Shantay passes]] can trade either [[Shantay guard]] to access the [[Shantay Pass Shop]].
=== Skill training areas ===

* [[Ruins of Unkah mine]]
* The fire and pot next to the entrance of the pier can be used to cook food. Despite its appearance and name, this actually functions as a [[range]]. There is another everlasting fire near the hilltop ruins, but it will not act as a range, and is further from a bank.
* In addition to access to [[Tempoross]] via the docks, there are three [[fishing spot (cage, harpoon)|cage/harpoon fishing spots]] just outside the ruin limits that are not subject to [[desert heat]].

Additionally, a [[damp egg]] can be found by searching the south-westernmost crate in the building with the [[Altar (Ruins of Unkah)|ruined altar]], and the [[book table]] in the library building can be searched for [[The desert trout - ship's log|''The Desert Trout''<nowiki/>'s ship log]] and the [[Spirit anglers research notes|spirit anglers' research notes]]. Lastly, several [[Kharidian cactus|Kharidian cacti]] pepper the area.

== Inhabitants ==

===Personalities===
* {{Chatl|Captain Dudi}}, a captain of the Spirit Anglers.
* {{Chatl|Captain Pudi}}, the founding captain of the Spirit Anglers, who tries to recruit new members.
* {{Chatl|Ferryman Nathwood}}, who can ferry players to [[Al Kharid]].
* {{Chatl|Gita Prymes}}, who trades players pieces of the [[spirit angler's outfit]].
* {{Chatl|Ishmael}}, who sells fish and fish accessories.
* {{Chatl|Koanee}}, a strange lady who collects eggs.
* {{Chatl|Lauretta}}, a normal lady who doesn't collect eggs.
* {{Chatl|Retired sailor}}, who exchanges items for [[soaked pages]].
* 2 {{Chatl|Shantay Guard (Ruins of Unkah)|text=Shantay guards}}, who let players with a [[Shantay pass (item)|pass]] in and out of the ruins.
* {{Chatl|Sailor (Ruins of Unkah)|text=Sailor}}, a man of little words who directs players to the captains.
* 4 {{Chatl|Spirit Angler|text=spirit anglers|pic=Spirit Angler (2) chathead}}, who wander the area preparing to fight [[Tempoross]].
* 1 more {{Chatl|Spirit Angler (Reward pool)|text=spirit angler}}, who runs the [[Reward pool|reward shop]].
* {{Chatl|Spotter Virginia}}, a high-level crewmate who is very good as spotting things.
* {{Chatl|Taiman}}, a former skipper who lost the boat to [[Tempoross]].
* {{Chatl|Timallus}}, a strange man who mourns the dampness of eggs.

=== Monsters ===
* [[Crocodile]] (x4)
* [[Scorpion]] (x6)
* [[Seagull]] (x3)
==Sailing info==
Players can [[mooring point|dock]] at the Ruins of Unkah with level 48 [[Sailing]]. The southernmost dock offers the following utilities for sailors:
*[[File:Port task board icon.png|link=Notice board]] [[Notice board]]
*[[File:Salvaging station map icon.png|link=Salvaging station]] [[Salvaging station]]
*[[File:Ledger table icon.png|link=Ledger table]] [[Ledger table]]
*[[File:Crew registrar_icon.png|link=Crew registrar]] [[Crew Registrar]]
*[[File:Bank icon.png|link=Bank deposit box]] [[Bank deposit box]]

The bank chest here is the second [[closest]] bank to a salvaging station, behind only the [[bank boat]] used in conjunction with a [[salvaging station (facility)|salvaging station boat facility]].
